actualCollectionReview.result: 50 independent compositions actually viewed: varied snowman proportions, faces, hat cuts, scarves, actions, duos, ornaments, felt garland, paper craft, two lettering compositions and four separate black-and-white coloring scenes. Existing family-building and reindeer-meeting scenes were excluded. No repair or medium variant counted as an extra original.
